scope: Strict private response contract for the location-scoped planning-budget summary endpoint.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at page and plan levels
constraints.counts: strict integers; budget_line_count is positive; all other counts are nonnegative
constraints.financial_values: finite numbers; signed budget variance semantics are retained
constraints.privacy: plan names/objectives, category labels, notes, vendor/counterparty, transaction identifiers, scenario assumptions, and evidence URLs are excluded
constraints.request_binding: response location_id and offset must match the request; response list cannot exceed requested limit
constraints.pagination: next_offset must equal offset plus limit when has_more; continuation stops at offset 10,000

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This source/API contract does not establish populated-data parity, live OIDC behavior, or broader tenant isolation.
